events.title_original: Houthi rebels close in on Aden, Yemeni forces dig in behind fortified line
events.summary: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have advanced to within about 60 kilometers of the seat of Yemen’s internationally recognized government in the southern city of Aden, but the forces fighting them have set up a fortified line to defend the city, a military official said Tuesday.
